comment: A trimmed snapshot of the live LiteLLM catalogue (JorisJonkers-dev/litellm-model-catalog, model-catalog.json), in its own shape: every probed model per provider route with its status, reason, free mark and modality (unprobed ones left out), and the canonical groups. scripts/litellm_catalogue.py reads it when setup has fetched no live copy, and tests/test_litellm_models.py checks the gateway defaults against it. Refresh: gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" repos/JorisJonkers-dev/litellm-model-catalog/contents/model-catalog.json | jq --arg comment "$(jq -r .comment registry/litellm-catalogue.json)" '{comment: $comment, version, updated_at, providers: (.providers | map_values({models: [.models[] | select(.metadata.status != "unprobed") | {id, metadata: (.metadata | {status, reason, free, modality})}]})), groups}' > registry/litellm-catalogue.json.new && mv registry/litellm-catalogue.json.new registry/litellm-catalogue.json
